channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: IndiGo Q2 preview: Can higher airfares protect margins as fuel costs surge?
item.description: IndiGo’s September-quarter earnings will test whether higher fares and fuel surcharges can offset rising jet-fuel prices, a weaker rupee and slowing passenger demand.

item.title: Anthropic diversifies AI chips, OpenAI turns to Google: Can Nvidia lose its dominance? What investors need to know
item.description: Anthropic is spreading its AI computing across Amazon, Google, Nvidia and AMD chips, potentially reducing reliance on Nvidia and strengthening its negotiating position.&nbsp;

item.title: OpenAI turns to Google’s AI chips amid race to challenge Nvidia
item.description: OpenAI plans to buy AI chips from Google as it expands computing capacity, according to a person familiar with the discussions. The potential purchase complements plans to use in-house chips later this year and reflects efforts across the industry to develop alternatives to Nvidia processors.

item.title: Ashes, India series result in record revenue, net surplus for Cricket Australia
item.description: Ashes, India series result in record revenue, net surplus for Cricket Australia

item.title: Lab Rats series: A Pune biotech startup’s new approach to vitiligo cure
item.description: Ahammune has advanced its first-in-class drug to solve vitiligo to mid-trials with a fraction of the cost of global peers. It’s not been an easy road, but the tide is turning.

item.title: Just Dial wants more paying merchants. Software is its next big bet
item.description: Just Dial, which currently generates most of its revenue from paid listings and subscriptions, is now testing new merchant software products to expand its offerings, its chief executive officer Dinkar Ayilavarapu said.

item.title: Cognizant restructures software engineering business as clients seek AI returns
item.description: The restructuring is part of Cognizant’s efforts to prepare for an AI-driven market, where companies are reassessing the work they outsource to technology services providers. It is arguably the largest organizational overhaul under chief executive Ravi Kumar, who took charge in January 2023.

item.title: TVS family feud: Venu Srinivasan, son and wife along with daughter file caveats
item.description: TVS Motor Co. chairman-emeritus Venu Srinivasan, son Sudarshan Venu, wife Mallika Srinivasan, and daughter Lakshmi Venu have filed a total of eight caveats in two Chennai courts

item.title: ASM Lifts 2027 Outlook as AI Buildout Fuels Demand For Tools
item.description: ASM International NV increased its revenue target for next year by about 24%, setting up the chip-equipment maker to hit its 2030 goal three years ahead of schedule, on a surge in sales linked to AI investments.

item.title: The HRX Case Study: How Hrithik Roshan leveraged sweat equity, Myntra’s supply chain to conquer Indian activewear market
item.description: Hrithik Roshan's HRX grew from a fitness-inspired clothing label into a brand spanning apparel, footwear and more. Its partnership with Myntra, mass-market pricing and focus on product quality helped it scale, with reported revenue exceeding ₹1,500 crore.

item.title: Tata Motors’ €3.43 bn Iveco bid sees 87.8% acceptance, paves way for biggest buyout since JLR: What exchange filing says
item.description: Tata Motors’ bid for Italian truckmaker Iveco cleared the 80% acceptance threshold, with 87.81% of common shares tendered by the October 26 deadline. The deal, valued at about EUR 3.8 billion, would expand Tata’s global commercial vehicle business.

item.title: Who are Roman Saini and Gaurav Munjal: From founding online coaching to becoming venture capitalists with ₹700 cr fund
item.description: The fund has reportedly secured ₹250-300 crore in commitments and plans to back 25-28 early-stage startups, with its first close targeted for January 2027

item.title: Inside India's first Kachra Cafe, where Bhopal residents exchange household waste for food, drinks and other essentials
item.description: Bhopal's Kachra Cafe lets residents exchange recyclable household waste for food, drinks and essentials. Led by Anjeeta Sabhlok with the municipal corporation, the initiative has reportedly sent more than 45 tonnes of waste for recycling in eight months.

item.title: Who is Akshit Choudhary? Indian Overseas Bank names new CFO; Check his qualifications and previous roles
item.description: Akshit Choudhary is a chartered accountant with more than 15 years of professional experience across banking, financial services, auditing, treasury and business operations. Choudhary will take over as CFO from Madhaw Chandra Jha with effect from November 1, 2026.

item.title: From city civil courts to Madras HC to NCLT: Why TVS camps are filing caveats across courts amid succession dispute
item.description: The TVS family succession dispute has moved toward litigation, with both camps filing caveats in multiple courts to prevent rulings without hearing their arguments. The dispute involves Venu Srinivasan, his wife Mallika and their children, amid unresolved questions over family wealth and ownership.

item.title: Exports, EVs help Bajaj Auto’s Q2 profit surge amid rising costs, looming rural stress
item.description: Strong overseas demand and a favourable exchange rate lift quarterly earnings, even as the two-wheeler maker flags rural distress and weak demand for entry-level motorcycles.

item.title: War in West Asia was a cloud over L&T. The company has come out shining
item.description: L&amp;T reported ₹1.48 trillion in new orders during the quarter, over a fourth more than the same period last year, taking its consolidated orderbook to a record ₹8.5 trillion—an impressive feat given that war-torn West Asis is its biggest market outside India.

item.title: Nalwa Aero tests electric flying taxi: Indian startups ‘set to redefine how we fly’, says Minister Rammohan Naidu
item.description: The Punjab-based company explores air taxis, medical evacuations and cargo transport; the aircraft requires further testing and regulatory approvals before commercial operations.

item.title: SC bars creditors from withdrawing insolvency plan over improved finances
item.description: Under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), neither the CoC nor the resolution applicant can withdraw the approved resolution merely by stating that certain developments have made the transaction less attractive, rules the SC.

item.title: Microsoft's voluntary exit offer to 60k employees explained: What is a buyout and how will it affect Indians?
item.description: Microsoft offers voluntary buyouts to eligible employees in the US, the UK, Canada and India as it reshapes its workforce amid rising AI investments. Here’s what the offer means, who qualifies, the reported severance benefits and how Indian employees, particularly H-1B holders, could be affected.

item.title: Maruti Suzuki flags rural demand risks as Q2 profit falls 26%
item.description: India’s largest carmaker reported a third straight quarterly decline in profit as rising input costs squeezed margins, even as sales volumes grew 27%.

item.title: Yes Bank AT1 bondholders seek regulatory, govt intervention to enforce SC order
item.description: Yes Bank's AT-1 bondholders said many investors had relied on their retirement savings, including provident fund and gratuity, to purchase the bonds. Twelve members died during the court proceedings, according to its submissions.

item.title: JLR bets on local assembly, EVs to defend India luxury car ranking
item.description: The Tata Motors-owned carmaker expects local assembly to cut Defender SUV prices by up to 20% as it seeks to narrow the gap with Mercedes-Benz and BMW in India’s luxury car market.

item.title: Risks spelled out for Anthropic investors include blowback from runaway AI
item.description: Risks spelled out for Anthropic investors include blowback from runaway AI

item.title: L&T Q2 profit up 33% on healthy order inflow despite Iran war
item.description: Larsen &amp; Toubro's (L&amp;T) order inflows rose 28% to ₹1.48 lakh crore in July-September 2026 with international orders making up 63% of the total.

item.title: This startup from IIT Kanpur boys wants to make infrared chips 100 times cheaper to help drones see through smoke, haze
item.description: Bengaluru-based Nova Spectral AI raised $2.25 million to develop short-wave infrared sensor chips in India. Using colloidal quantum dots, the startup aims to make sensors up to 100 times cheaper than conventional models, with a field-ready prototype planned within 18 months.

item.title: Jio, Airtel add over 5.3 million mobile users in September as India’s subscriber base crosses 1.3 billion
item.description: The number of wireless mobile subscribers rose from 1,293.43 million at the end of August to 1,300 million by the end of September, marking a monthly growth rate of 0.51%.

item.title: Advent International raises $30 billion across two new funds, beats flagship target
item.description: The global private equity firm secured nearly $27 billion for its flagship GPE XI fund alongside $3 billion for a new mid-market strategy, backed by strong realizations of $13 billion in 2026.

item.title: Maruti Suzuki profit misses estimate as costs squeeze margins
item.description: Maruti Suzuki saw small car sales increasing 35.9% in Q2 FY27 and SUV sales by 68.2% with demand continuing to outpace supply.

item.title: Cent raises $15 million to scale preventive health screening business
item.description: Bengaluru-based preventive health startup Cent raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Blume Ventures and South Park Commons. It plans to invest in research, AI radiology and screening technology, and expand from three centres to 7–10 across Bengaluru, Mumbai and Gurugram by mid-2027.

item.title: Under scanner for Tiger Shroff shooting, Pune Police asks Google, Apple to remove Rapido app for operating illegally
item.description: Rapido could be removed from app stores in Pune as police crack down on its unlicensed bike taxi services. The company’s approval application remains pending, and authorities have warned of legal action.

item.title: Tata Consumer’s distribution overhaul powers growth in more businesses, says CEO
item.description: A distribution overhaul has helped make growth businesses a key engine for Tata Consumer Products. The company is expanding AI tools across sales and tea production, while price hikes and premium products support growth despite inflation and softer demand.

item.title: Diwali sweets: luxury mithai brands make a beeline for premium gifting market
item.description: Diwali is driving a push into high-end mithai, with boxes priced up to ₹21,000 and brands blending traditional sweets with premium ingredients and contemporary flavours. However, premium mithai is still a tiny share of India’s sweets market.

item.title: ‘Consider not taxing severance’: Investor urges FM amid Microsoft VEO, reiterates need of savings as layoffs continue
item.description: Microsoft’s new Voluntary Exit Offer has prompted investor Muthukrishnan Dhandapani to warn of further tech-sector job losses and economic fallout. He urged workers to avoid major investments and maintain savings, saying the transition to new opportunities could be painful.

item.title: Unicorn India Ventures’ US expansion aimed at speeding up portfolio growth and exits
item.description: Founder Bhaskar Majumdar tells Mint how the VC firm's new US base will connect Indian portfolio companies with American co-investors and buyers while keeping its funding focus firmly on India.
